fields.description: Total hours actually worked per adjusted patient day.  Adjusted patient days are calculated using the following formula:  Total gross patient revenue divided by gross inpatient revenue times the number of patient days.  The purpose of "adjusting" the patient days is to recognize outpatient utilization.
